[ce] Find All Minima and Maxima of f(x).vi

Owning Palette: Zeroes and Extrema

The VI searches for all local minima and maxima of a 1D function in the specified interval. In addition, the VI allows specifying additional parameters and evaluating them in formula.

Click the parameters for more information

 

accuracy. Controls the accuracy of the determined zeros and extrema.
# points. Number of all calculated points.
start. Start point of the interval under investigation.
end. End point of the interval under investigation.
formula info.
formula. A string describing the function under investigation.
x-variable.
error in describes error conditions that occur before this VI runs. This input provides standard error in functionality.
status indicates error status.
code contains error code.
source contains additional error information.
parameters. Array of clusters describing optional parameters that may be used in formula. Cluster consist of parameter name and value.
name parameter name
value parameter value
maxima.
x. The determined maxima of formula.
f(x). The function values at maxima points.
minima.
x. The determined minima of formula.
f(x). The function values at minima point
ticks. Time in milliseconds to produce the results.
error out contains error information. This output provides standard error out functionality.
status indicates error status.
code contains error code.
source contains additional error information.
